headline: 29 trades net -1.5 bps/bet (-44.9 total); recent 15-trade window gross -9.0 / net -12.0 bps — weak but still thin.
alert_message: Recent 15-trade window is gross-negative (-9 bps) and overall gross edge (~+1.5 bps) sits below the ~4 bps expected and below breakeven — worth watching, not yet a confirmed breakdown.
regime_note: BTC ~$81.3k, pinned near the top of the recent $76-81k range; signal is flat (0), so nothing is live right now. The sample spans a big regime shift from the $63-66k cluster (mostly losers) to the $77-81k cluster (mixed).
assessment_md:
**How it's doing.** Across all 29 resolved live trades the strategy is net **-1.5 bps per bet** (-44.9 bps cumulative) and wins only **37.9%** of the time. Backing out the assumed 3.0 bps cost, gross edge is roughly **+1.5 bps/bet** — positive, but well under the ~4 bps we hoped for and under the ~3.9 bps breakeven. In plain terms: as traded, it is not showing net profit.

**What changed vs last time.** Very little. The ledger is unchanged (still 29 trades, -44.9 bps total). The rolling window is essentially the same picture: the most recent ~15 trades are **gross -9.0 / net -12.0 bps**, i.e. the recent stretch is worse than the full history. A couple of big winners (+48.7, +25.9 bps on short signals) are carrying the record; strip those and it looks poor.

**What the numbers do and don't tell us.** With only 29 trades — and this signal firing on ~1-2% of candles — this is a *tiny* sample. A single large move can swing the average by several bps, so neither the losing streak nor the occasional big win is conclusive. Separately, the edge search found **0 survivors** that clear a positive net at 5 bps cost on both venues, consistent with a genuinely marginal edge.

**Bottom line.** No evidence of profit, some early signs of weakness in the recent window, but the sample is too thin to declare a breakdown. Keep it running in monitor-only mode and reassess as trades accumulate. No guaranteed edge here.
